### 常见 WHERE 值 (Common Filter Values)

- `regional_date`: `DATE('${TODAY}')` / `DATE('${1_DAYS_AGO}')` ~70% 查询
- `regional_hour`: `'${hour}'` 或固定值如 `'00'`, `'01'`, `'06'`, `'09'`, `'11'`
- `country`: `IN ('ID','TH','PH','VN','MY','TW','SG')` ~85% 查询 / `'BR'` (US market) / `'SG'` (single-country drill-down)
- `is_sampled`: `= true` (几乎 100% 查询)
- `item_type`: `IS NOT NULL` (~50%) / `IN ('TARGET_ROI2', 'SIMPLE_ROI2')` (DQC/聚合场景) / `!= 'ORGANIC'` (排除自然商品)
- `request_id`: `IS NOT NULL` (~60%) / `!= '' AND != '0'` (漏斗分析)
- `ads_id > 0`, `shop_id > 0`, `user_id > 0` (基础数据质量过滤)
- `is_mixrank = true` (混排阶段分析)
- `entrance IN ('product_detail_page','daily_discover_main')` (rcmd bundle 过滤，DQC 场景常用)
- `mixrank_remove_reason != 'MIXRANK_TRUNCATED'` (DQC 场景排除混排截断数据)
- `ABS(HASH(request_id)) % 10 = 0` (PySpark 10% 请求采样)

### Search vs Rcmd 粗排 Ext 字段差异

粗排阶段，Rcmd 和 Search 表使用不同的 JSON Ext 字段：

| 阶段 | Rcmd 使用 | Search 使用 |
|------|-----------|-------------|
| 粗排分数 | `ads_recall_ext.prerank_score` | `ads_info_ext.prerank_score` |
| 粗排 pCTR | `ads_recall_ext.lite_pctr` | `ads_info_ext.lite_pctr` |
| 粗排 pCR | `ads_recall_ext.lite_pcr` | `ads_info_ext.lite_pcr` |
| 粗排出价 | `ads_recall_ext.prerank_bid` / 100000.0 | `ads_info_ext.prerank_bid` / 100000.0 |
| 粗排位置 | `ads_recall_ext.position` | `ads_info_ext.position` |
| 商品价格 | rank_item_price (原生列) | `ads_info_ext.item_price` / 100000.0 |
| 商品销量 | `ads_recall_ext.avg_sold_cnt_item` | `ads_info_ext.avg_sold_cnt_item` |

PAbV 公式差异：
- **Rcmd**: `rank_item_price * avg_sold_cnt_item * (0.3 * rank_pcr + 0.7 * rank_broad_pcr) * pid_coef * target_cir / 100000.0`
- **Search**: `pgmv * target_cir / 100000.0`（简化为 pgmv 驱动）
